text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

words.gloss_range: emphatic confirming particle that governs the whole rationale clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the ayah by making the night-rising rationale an asserted fact, not a loose devotional comment. Its scope covers the construct subject and both coordinated predicate units, so the pressure claim and the speech claim stand inside one confirmed explanation after the earlier commands (73:2-4). The doubled nūn gives the opening a brief acoustic tightening before the night-rising is named and before intensity becomes the first predicate. The particle also pairs with the preceding ayah's opening assertion: the heavy word announced in 73:5 is followed by a confirmed reason why the night setting bears it.

topics.headline: confirmed rationale over both predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah argues for night-rising as one confirmed rationale whose two evaluations belong together.
topics.reason: The attachment data identifies one {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) clause extending through the two predicate terms, matching the rows that treat the particle as clause-wide assertion.

topics.headline: assertion answers the prior heavy word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from command and promised weight to an explicit explanation of why night practice is fit for that weight.
topics.reason: The row family coherently links the sentence-initial assertion to the surrounding discourse, while local grammar keeps the claim inside this ayah's single clause.

topics.headline: brief acoustic tightening before the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening particle audibly tightens before the ayah names the night-rising whose first predicate is intensity.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local and modest; it supports cadence awareness without controlling the grammatical parse.

words.gloss_range: night-rising as an emergent state or event, locally the accusative subject of the emphatic clause
words.root_gloss_range: arising, growing, originating, and being formed; the local noun concentrates that formation pressure in the night-vigil

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening emphatic particle governing the night-rising phrase
genitive second member of the construct phrase
feminine separator pronoun resuming the night-rising phrase

words.prose: {{ar:نَاشِئَةَ}} ({{tr:nāshiʾata}}) is seized by {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) as the asserted subject and bound to {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) in construct. Its {{ar:ن ش أ}} ({{tr:n-sh-ʾ}}) field makes the vigil an arising or formed condition, not merely a scheduled act in darkness. The active-participial noun compresses the rising person, the rising act, and the resulting state, so the emergent night-state is positioned as the source from which the final speech product is formed. The feminine form also anchors {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}), keeping both later evaluations attached to this night-rising state. The Hafs surface keeps the internal hamza as a small audible threshold; variant smoothing narrows the sound claim but does not remove the same referent, because the emergence remains even when the articulation is softened.

topics.headline: asserted construct subject of both predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the night-rising is the grammatically secured bearer of both intensity and upright speech.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm accusative {{ar:نَاشِئَةَ}} ({{tr:nāshiʾata}}) as the governed subject, construct head, and antecedent resumed by the feminine separator.

topics.headline: vigil as formative emergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word casts night practice as a state coming into being and forming the self over time.
topics.reason: The root-family rows are locally licensed by the surface noun; contextual evidence marks this nominal use as rare, strengthening the formative reading without replacing the local grammar.

topics.headline: active-participial noun fuses actor, event, and state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen noun compresses the rising person, the rising act, and the resulting condition into one expression.
topics.reason: The local form supports the rows contrasting this expression with a plainer standing noun; the point is form-specific rather than a new lexical sense.

topics.headline: hamza threshold with variant softening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Hafs surface as a small audible threshold, while accepted smoothing shows that the meaning does not depend on that catch alone.
topics.reason: The hamza observation survives for the local surface, but the variant evidence narrows it so the sound cannot be made the sole basis of the semantic claim.

topics.headline: emergence leads toward upright utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the emergent night-state is positioned as the source from which the final speech product is formed.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and same-surah rows are concrete and agree with the local sequence from subject to final speech predicate, with references such as 73:2 kept as contextual support.

words.gloss_range: the definite night as the genitive domain defining the rising
words.root_gloss_range: night, darkness, and reduced outward activity; locally a definite temporal medium rather than a mere adverb
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) is genitive inside the construct, so night defines the rising rather than hovering as background time. Its definiteness makes it the recognized night-frame already active in the surah, while its singular noun form treats night as a coherent medium rather than one countable night-unit. That frame explains why the ayah can move from reduced outward signal to stronger imprint and straighter utterance; within the surah, it explains the night command of 73:2 and anticipates the later recalibration in 73:20. The local cadence also moves from the liquid night-word through the separator into the heavier pressure predicate, and the frame prepares the contrast with daytime occupation in 73:7.

topics.headline: night as construct-defining domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is grammatically built into the rising as its defining medium, not added as a detachable circumstance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) as genitive second member of the construct, supporting source and temporal-frame payoffs without choosing one exclusively.

topics.headline: dark interval as formative medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why night, as a lowered-outward-signal domain, can be linked to deeper imprint and clearer speech.
topics.reason: The lexical rows align with the local night-frame and with the following pressure and speech predicates; the root dispute is kept as morphology awareness, not a change of sense.

topics.headline: singular definite night as unified frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents night as a known recurring domain rather than one countable night-unit.
topics.reason: The local noun form and construct role support the rows that distinguish this usage from adverbial or countable night wording.

topics.headline: same-surah night-standing frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 73:6 explains the night command of 73:2 and anticipates the later recalibration in 73:20.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references are compatible with the local definite night and help place this ayah as the rationale for the night-standing frame.

topics.headline: quiet night sound before pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local cadence that moves from the liquid night-word through the separator into the heavier pressure predicate.
topics.reason: The sound claim is local and follows the surface sequence; it is retained as cadence payoff, not as a semantic override.

topics.headline: night claim prepares day contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the night rationale is part of a night/day allocation that continues in 73:7.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete forward relation to 73:7, and nothing in local grammar blocks the contrast.

words.gloss_range: feminine separator pronoun resuming the night-rising subject before the predicates

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first comparative predicate after the separator

words.prose: {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) resumes the feminine night-rising phrase and acts as a separator before {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu}}). That placement blocks an adjective-only reading and makes the following comparatives full predicates of one subject. It also creates a light structural and acoustic hinge: the reader pauses on the night-rising itself, after the quiet night frame and before the first heavy predicate, before hearing its two measured qualities.

topics.headline: separator forces full predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the qualities are asserted of the night-rising itself rather than attached as loose description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) as resuming the subject before predication, which supports separator force.

topics.headline: feminine agreement keeps the subject visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun spotlights the night-rising phrase and prevents the predicates from drifting to another referent.
topics.reason: The feminine singular pronoun matches the prior feminine head and locally focuses the same subject.

topics.headline: light hinge before the dual predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a structural and acoustic pause between the quiet night frame and the first heavy predicate.
topics.reason: The hinge claim follows the attested sequence and discourse boundary; it remains cadence and discourse payoff rather than a new syntactic relation.

words.gloss_range: more intense, stronger, tighter; locally the first comparative predicate specified by the following tamyiz
words.root_gloss_range: tightening, binding, severity, strength, and full force; locally redirected into disciplined pressure rather than punishment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative specification narrowing the domain of intensity

words.prose: {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu}}) is the first nominative predicate under the separator and the emphatic clause. As an elative without an expressed comparison term, it grades the night-rising as more intense while leaving the rival implicit. The {{ar:ش د د}} ({{tr:sh-d-d}}) field gives the claim tight, concentrated force, but {{ar:وَطْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:waṭʾan}}) narrows that force to imprint and pressure rather than punishment language. The doubled surface makes the word naming intensity feel compressed in recitation, and its first position lets embodied intensity become the entry point before the ayah turns to upright speech. That inward nocturnal intensity also belongs to a wider severity arc that later escalates into cosmic severity in 73:14.

topics.headline: first predicate as open comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that intensity is asserted as a comparative quality of night-rising, with the comparison standard left open.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu}}) a predicate and marks the comparison standard as elided, preserving the open comparative force.

topics.headline: severity redirected into disciplined pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a taut, gathered intensity, while the following specification keeps it from becoming generic threat or punishment.
topics.reason: The root range supports strength and severity, but local tamyiz {{ar:وَطْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:waṭʾan}}) narrows the active domain to pressure and imprint.

topics.headline: geminated sound enacts compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubled surface makes the word naming intensity feel compressed in recitation.
topics.reason: The sound-form rows are local and consistent with the geminate root; they are retained as phonetic reinforcement.

topics.headline: embodied pressure before verbal rectitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first measures embodied pressure and only then coordinates verbal uprightness with it.
topics.reason: The local sequence and coordination make the first predicate a complete axis before the second elative arrives.

topics.headline: inward intensity before later cosmic severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this inward nocturnal intensity participates in a wider severity arc, including the later escalation in 73:14.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah reference to 73:14 supports an echo, while local grammar keeps 73:6 focused on disciplined practice.

words.gloss_range: imprint, pressure, treading, accord, and grounding; locally an accusative tamyiz specifying the domain of greater intensity
words.root_gloss_range: stepping, pressing, bedding or preparation, and conformity; locally these remain tied to measured pressure, not to a direct object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: comparative governor for the pressure specification

words.prose: {{ar:وَطْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:waṭʾan}}) is the accusative specification of {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu}}), so it names the respect in which night-rising is more intense. The word does not introduce something trodden; it measures pressure as imprint, contact, and inward accord. Its rare {{ar:و ط أ}} ({{tr:w-ṭ-ʾ}}) field lets footfall become correspondence: night effort aligns body, heart, and utterance, contrasting with false external conformity in 9:37. Accepted variant shapes widen the support and bedding side of the field, but the local written form keeps the clipped hamzated pressure in view. Structurally, this pressure noun completes the first measured axis before speech appears, and across the boundary it turns the heavy word of 73:5 into pressure that leaves an imprint.

topics.headline: specification, not object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word tells how intensity is measured, rather than naming an object being stepped on.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence syntactically forces {{ar:وَطْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:waṭʾan}}) as tamyiz for {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu}}), blocking object-like overreadings.

topics.headline: contact pressure becomes inward accord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that physical treading and inner correspondence are held together, so pressure becomes productive alignment.
topics.reason: The root rows cohere with the local pressure predicate and the following speech predicate; no evidence requires reducing the field to only physical footfall or only abstraction.

topics.headline: variant range adds support without replacing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variant textures open support and bedding associations while the local reading still foregrounds clipped pressure.
topics.reason: The variant evidence is valid for range and contrast, but it is narrowed so it does not replace the canonical local surface.

topics.headline: rare root contrasts false and true conformity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same rare root can mark false external matching in 9:37 and ethical inward fit here.
topics.reason: The concrete 9:37 contrast survives as an inter-ayah payoff, while local grammar keeps 73:6 on night-formed alignment.

topics.headline: first measured axis before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pressure completes the first measured axis before the second axis of speech appears.
topics.reason: The local structure creates two elative-plus-tamyiz units; this word closes the first unit before the conjunction.

topics.headline: hamzated stop and emphatic texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clipped hamza and emphatic consonant make the pressure word feel pressed in recitation.
topics.reason: The acoustic rows are anchored in the local surface and reinforce the lexical pressure field.

topics.headline: heavy word becomes imprint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from the heavy word of 73:5 into pressure that leaves an imprint in 73:6.
topics.reason: The 73:5 boundary row is concrete and matches the local shift from heavy reception to measured pressure.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the second comparative predicate to the first

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: complete first elative-plus-specification unit before the conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second comparative unit with the first. It does not mark the speech claim as a later result or subordinate explanation; it places pressure and upright speech as paired measures under one subject and one assertion. Because it comes after the complete {{ar:أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu waṭʾan}}) unit, it both separates the two domains and binds them into a balanced claim. After the clipped pressure word, the small connector gives a light release into the second comparative while preserving the paired architecture.

topics.headline: coequal predicate coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pressure and speech are coequal measures of the night-rising, not cause and later effect.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:أَقْوَمُ}} ({{tr:ʾaqwamu}}) with {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ʾashaddu}}) inside the same clause, supporting non-subordinate pairing.

topics.headline: boundary between two complete units
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction joins two full elative-plus-specification units rather than blending them into one adjective phrase.
topics.reason: The first tamyiz completes the prior unit before the conjunction introduces the second predicate.

topics.headline: light release from pressure into uprightness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small connector releases the clipped pressure word into the second comparative while preserving the paired architecture.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows are local and coherent with the grammar, but they remain secondary to the coordination function.

words.gloss_range: more upright, better established, straighter, more correct; locally the second comparative predicate specified by speech
words.root_gloss_range: standing, establishing, straightening, correcting, and maintaining; locally applied to utterance as comparative rectitude

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative specification fixing the domain as utterance

words.prose: {{ar:أَقْوَمُ}} ({{tr:ʾaqwamu}}) is the second comparative predicate inside the same asserted clause. Its {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field turns correctness into an image of speech that can stand straight, remain established, and be set right. The elative form grades that rectitude without naming the rival, while its hollow-root middle glide remains audible inside the comparative that claims uprightness. {{ar:قِيلًا}} ({{tr:qīlan}}) fixes the domain as utterance itself, so the paired elatives first balance force and rectitude, then their specifications distinguish pressure from speech. Same-surah echoes make the payoff larger: the command to stand at night in 73:2 ripens here into speech made straighter, and 73:20 later returns to standing and recitation. The same comparative quality associated with guidance in 17:9 is applied here to speech formed from the heavy-word boundary of 73:5.

topics.headline: coordinated comparative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that verbal uprightness is asserted with the same grammatical weight as the prior pressure claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:أَقْوَمُ}} ({{tr:ʾaqwamu}}) as a predicate and marks the comparison standard as unexpressed.

topics.headline: speech can stand correctly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word pictures utterance as straightened, corrected, and made able to stand.
topics.reason: The root range supports standing, establishing, and correcting, and the following tamyiz confines that rectitude to speech.

topics.headline: elative grades rectitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah chooses comparative rectitude rather than a simple description of straightness.
topics.reason: The exact comparative form is locally attested and distributionally small, so the form-specific comparison is meaningful.

topics.headline: inner root stability heard in the elative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root's middle glide surfacing inside the comparative that claims uprightness.
topics.reason: The surface observation is form-specific and supports the rectitude field without creating an independent sense.

topics.headline: commanded standing becomes upright speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standing command of 73:2 returns as a quality of speech in 73:6 and is echoed again in 73:20.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah references to 73:2 and 73:20 support the transformation from standing practice to upright utterance.

topics.headline: rectitude links guidance and heavy-word boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same comparative quality associated with guidance in 17:9 is applied here to speech formed from the heavy-word boundary of 73:5.
topics.reason: The 17:9 and 73:5 references provide concrete contrast and boundary payoff, while the local tamyiz keeps the active domain as utterance.

topics.headline: paired elative moves from force to rectitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two matching elatives create a balanced evaluation, then their specifications distinguish pressure from speech.
topics.reason: The local coordination and matching form support the paired-measure payoff.

words.gloss_range: utterance, speech-product, what is said; locally an indefinite accusative tamyiz specifying the domain of uprightness
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, utterance, attribution, and speech-content; locally the product of utterance is evaluated rather than a quoted report

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: comparative governor measuring uprightness in speech
prior heavy word that the final speech noun answers across the boundary

words.prose: {{ar:قِيلًا}} ({{tr:qīlan}}) closes the ayah as the accusative specification of {{ar:أَقْوَمُ}} ({{tr:ʾaqwamu}}). It is not a quotation or direct object; it names the domain in which uprightness is measured, and its indefiniteness keeps night-formed utterance qualitative rather than fixed to one speech event. The compact {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) form foregrounds the speech-product, the thing said, more than the speaker's performance, while the broader family contrast with imposed or fabricated saying sharpens the need for rectified utterance. Against {{ar:قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا}} ({{tr:qawlan thaqīlan}}) in 73:5, the boundary shifts from a heavy word received to utterance made steadier and more upright through the night-rising. The final position makes speech the ayah's landing after the earlier pressure specification; the paired indefinite endings bind imprint to speech, and the long vowel gives the final word a smoother close before later speech instruction in 73:10 and the day contrast in 73:7.

topics.headline: speech as the measured domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that uprightness is measured in utterance itself, not in posture, status, or a quoted statement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence syntactically forces {{ar:قِيلًا}} ({{tr:qīlan}}) as tamyiz for {{ar:أَقْوَمُ}} ({{tr:ʾaqwamu}}), supporting domain specification.

topics.headline: indefinite speech as qualitative field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah speaks of night-formed utterance as a quality or class, not one fixed speech event.
topics.reason: The indefinite accusative form supports qualitative domain reading within the local tamyiz construction.

topics.headline: formed speech product, not performance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word foregrounds the stabilized thing said rather than the act or identity of the speaker.
topics.reason: The root and form rows cohere with the local evaluation of utterance as product; the common speech root does not make this a generic saying event.

topics.headline: upright speech against false attribution pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broader speech family includes imposed or fabricated saying, which sharpens the local concern for rectified utterance.
topics.reason: Derivative false-attribution senses are retained as contrast, but narrowed because the local word itself is the speech-product under uprightness, not an attribution verb.

topics.headline: heavy word becomes upright utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the handoff from the heavy word in 73:5 to stabilized speech at the end of 73:6.
topics.reason: The concrete 73:5 boundary rows support a form-shifted q-w-l handoff, while local grammar keeps {{ar:قِيلًا}} ({{tr:qīlan}}) as the final tamyiz.

topics.headline: final speech landing balances pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on speech after pairing it with the earlier pressure specification.
topics.reason: The final position and parallel tamyiz structure make speech the endpoint of the ayah's measured rationale.

topics.headline: paired endings and smoother landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that paired indefinite endings bind imprint to speech while the long vowel gives the final word a smoother landing.
topics.reason: The sound rows are local and reinforce the conceptual pairing without overriding grammar.

topics.headline: speech hinge between receiving and later saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 73:6 sits between the heavy word of 73:5 and later speech instruction in 73:10, before the day contrast in 73:7.
topics.reason: The same-surah references are concrete and compatible with the word's final speech-product role.

branches.image_en:
1. collecting and gathering
2. gathering speech into recitation

1. يدخل فيه أصل الجمع والاجتماع، وضم الشيء بعضه إلى بعض، وجمع الماء والطعام والناس والضيف، واجتماع عظام الظهر، وما ألحقته المقاييس بقرية من جهة الجمع.
2. قراءة القرآن والكلام؛ لفظه مجموعا؛ إقراء الغير؛ المدارسة والاستقراء؛ القارئ والقراء والتقرؤ للتنسك أو التفقه
branches.scope_en:

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ / أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا / أَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The night's enacted rising concentrates force into planted contact; that contact also matches one element to another, so bodily traction and uttered speech become one alignment mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Setting out and rising supplies the enacted emergence of the night practice.
Doing something by night makes the phrase an activity rather than a merely dark interval.
Strength and hardness provide the concentrated force of the comparative.
A foot treading a place gives the force a bodily point of contact.
One thing matching another turns contact into concordance between body and speech.
Straightness and evenness make speech the upright result of the alignment.
Uttered speech identifies the verbal surface on which uprightness appears.

changed_reading.before: Night practice is simply more effective for concentration and correct speech.
changed_reading.after: The night rising is an embodied concordance: firmer foot-contact and better-matched utterance are two outputs of the same alignment.

baseline_models.mechanism: Growth under severe pressure matures into a supporting structure. The verse can therefore describe capacity being formed by repeated nocturnal exertion, not only a favorable moment already possessing that capacity.

activation_trace.role: Growing into youth supplies a developmental rather than instantaneous nashi'ah.
Arrival at full strength makes intensity a stage of maturation.
Severe pressing supplies the resistance through which capacity develops.
A mainstay or support is the durable capacity produced by the pressure.
Earnest concern for something makes qila a sustained verbal commitment.

changed_reading.before: The night has a fixed advantage over other times.
changed_reading.after: Nocturnal exertion develops the strength by which committed speech can later stand as a support.

baseline_models.mechanism: Speech begins as an unvoiced inner saying, is brought into action, and is matched to outward utterance; aqwam names the straight fit between intention and voiced form.

activation_trace.role: Beginning speech or action makes the night the point where saying starts to form.
An unspoken inner saying supplies the inward pole of qila.
Uttered speech supplies the outward pole that must agree with the inner saying.
Mutual matching provides the bridge from inward conception to voiced expression.
Straightness names the integrity of the resulting inner-outer fit.

changed_reading.before: Qila denotes only speech made easier to pronounce at night.
changed_reading.after: The night is where an inward saying is initiated and brought into straighter agreement with what the tongue voices.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee moves from wrapped enclosure and carried load into bodily rising. Nashi'at al-layl becomes the transition from bundled passivity to upright agency.

activation_trace.role: Rising and setting out anchors the focus as an enacted transition.
Bodily standing supplies the upright endpoint already latent in aqwam.
Wrapping in garments supplies the enclosed starting posture from which the night rising emerges.
Carrying a load makes the wrapping also a burden to be borne into action.
The explicit command to stand converts the focus's uprightness from quality into movement.

structural_cues: The vocative to the bundled one in 73:1 is followed immediately by the command to stand in 73:2.
The same standing root returns comparatively as aqwam in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrapping, load, command, and rising; I infer a directional passage from enclosure to agency. The live alternative is that the vocative names only the addressee and contributes no process to 73:6.

changed_reading.before: Nashi'at al-layl names an isolated nocturnal occurrence.
changed_reading.after: It is the act of unbundling a burdened self into standing agency, culminating in bodily and verbal uprightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Standing, arranging recitation, receiving a cast saying, and bearing weight form a conditioning sequence. The focus's matching contact and supporting uprightness are adaptations for receiving and carrying the heavy utterance.

activation_trace.role: Matching makes nocturnal contact an adjustment of bearer to burden.
A mainstay supplies the load-bearing result of the adjustment.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter initiate the conditioning sequence.
Ordered arrangement gives the received saying a deliberately structured form.
Receiving speech turns the coming utterance into something the addressee must take up.
Uttered speech identifies the load as a saying rather than undifferentiated hardship.
Bearing a heavy load supplies the pressure for which nocturnal footing is trained.

structural_cues: The 73:2-5 sequence moves from standing through measured duration and ordered recitation to a heavy saying cast upon the addressee.
73:6 immediately explains that sequence with comparatives joining contact and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence stand, arrange, receive, and heavy saying; I infer that the earlier acts condition the bearer for the later load. The live alternative is a non-causal comparison in which night merely happens to be the clearest time for recitation.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a generic alignment available at night.
changed_reading.after: It describes a load-bearing reception protocol: ordered standing matches the bearer to a heavy utterance until that utterance can stand upright.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant mapping of focus qila to QLL lets the repeated qalilan activate fewness beneath the dominant speech reading. The result is a paronomastic model of upright speech delivered in deliberately small, bearable measures.

activation_trace.role: The split root's fewness branch places a small-measure echo under qila without replacing speech.
Carrying and rising lets the small verbal measure function as a bearable lifted load.
Equal weight and even measure make aqwam the calibration of the verbal dose.
The first qalilan supplies explicit smallness in the night-duration instruction.
The repeated qalilan reinforces small adjustment rather than maximal exertion.
A later little respite keeps measured smallness active beyond the opening instruction.

structural_cues: Qalilan closes 73:2 and 73:3, while qila closes 73:6; the packet explicitly retains QLL as a non-dominant mapped target for focus QWL.
The opening instructions repeatedly adjust duration by portions rather than demanding an undifferentiated maximum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated qalilan, focus qila, and the split mapping; I supply a sound-and-branch echo that overlays measured fewness on speech. The dominant and materially safer alternative remains ordinary QWL utterance with no QLL semantic transfer.

changed_reading.before: Aqwam qila means only more upright speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also hears upright speech as a carefully measured small verbal load, made bearable by dosing rather than excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Day opens into long, expansive movement, while night concentrates the practitioner at a point of contact. Ashaddu wat'an therefore becomes denser traction against daytime dispersal, not mere severity.

activation_trace.role: Night and darkness supply one pole of the explicit temporal contrast.
Concentrated pressure becomes the night pole's dense resistance and traction.
Straightness is the orientation preserved under that concentrated pressure.
Daylight opening supplies the exposed and expanded temporal field opposite night.
Expansive going about for livelihood makes daytime a field of dispersed mobility.
Long duration extends that mobility and sharpens the contrast with concentrated night contact.

structural_cues: 73:7 directly follows the focus and contrasts night with an extended daytime sabh.
The focus's contact image and the next ayah's movement image organize space differently: planted versus ranging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night, pressure, opened day, expansive movement, and duration; I infer concentration versus dispersal as the contrastive arrow. The live alternative is that sabh denotes ample free time, making day less distracting rather than more diffuse.

changed_reading.before: Night is stronger because it is intrinsically harder or quieter.
changed_reading.after: Night is stronger because it converts the self's long daytime circulation into concentrated traction and a single verbal orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lingual remembrance and deliberate severance shape an inward saying before it meets circulating public talk. Self-restraint and beautiful withdrawal then define upright qila as ethically governed response rather than verbal dominance.

activation_trace.role: The inner saying supplies the speech that is regulated before public encounter.
Straightness makes integrity, not force over others, the criterion of response.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies disciplined vocal practice.
Cutting and separation remove competing attachments from the speech-forming act.
Holding the self back from distress turns upright speech into controlled response.
Circulating talk supplies the social verbal pressure against which qila is tested.
Separation and departure provide the non-retaliatory action taken toward hostile talk.
Beauty in action qualifies withdrawal and makes restraint a positive verbal ethic.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from remembrance and exclusive turning in 73:8 to what others say and a beautiful withdrawal in 73:10.
The focus places qila under a comparative of uprightness before this social test appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vocal remembrance, separation, public talk, restraint, and beautiful withdrawal; I infer that night practice pre-forms the response later demanded. The live alternative is that the ritual and social commands are parallel obligations without a formative link.

changed_reading.before: Straighter qila is primarily clearer or more accurate recitation.
changed_reading.after: It is also speech ethically straightened before conflict: remembered inwardly, voiced without reactive capture, and capable of beautiful disengagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene removes every external support: ground shakes, solid mountains become a poured heap, harmful weight seizes, and sky splits. Against that field, the focus's planted foot and upright saying become a practiced counter-footing carried within the person.

activation_trace.role: Foot-treading supplies the local bodily ground that can be practiced before outer ground fails.
Uprightness supplies an internal orientation that does not depend on stable terrain.
Strength and hardness provide the resistance needed for counter-footing.
Violent shaking removes confidence in the ground underfoot.
A hard elevated mass supplies the apparent external stability that is about to collapse.
Poured granular matter converts the mountain's solidity into unstable flow.
Harmful heaviness turns weight from formative resistance into destructive seizure.
Opening and splitting extend the loss of support from earth to sky.

structural_cues: 73:14 transforms mountains from stable mass into a poured heap while the earth shakes.
The sequence adds a heavy seizure in 73:16 and a split sky in 73:18, widening instability from body and ground to the whole frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies planted contact, uprightness, shaking terrain, poured mountains, harmful heaviness, and split sky; I infer a micro-to-macro rehearsal in which nocturnal stability prepares for external dissolution. The live alternative is that the later material scene only warns and does not explain the practice in 73:6.

changed_reading.before: The vigil stabilizes an individual during ordinary distraction.
changed_reading.after: It rehearses a portable footing and upright utterance for the moment when even ground, mountain, and sky cease to support orientation.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence changes nocturnal standing from generic devotion into conditioning for receiving and bearing a heavy utterance.
The immediate daytime contrast changes severity into concentrated traction against long, expansive circulation.
The shaking earth, poured mountains, harmful weight, and split sky turn bodily footing and upright speech into portable stability when external supports fail.
The final ayah revises strength through measure, failed enumeration, ease, illness, and travel: effective contact is calibrated fit, not maximal hardship.
The retained non-dominant QLL mapping allows an exploratory echo in which qila carries the repeated qalilan as a small, bearable verbal measure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus couples a bodily contact term with verbal uprightness. Context repeatedly changes that coupling across load-bearing, social restraint, path-making, material collapse, and adaptive measure, while the split QWL mapping and distant wat' branches preserve controlled surprises that a single smooth interpretation would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet permits several nashi'ah images, so temporal rising, enacted practice, and developmental formation remain coexisting rather than resolved.
The causal claim that night practice conditions reception of the heavy saying comes from sequence and branch fit, not an explicit causal marker.
Whether 73:20 retrospectively defines the focus's strength or only grants a later concession remains open.
The QLL echo and the prosodic and gestational outliers are branch-grounded but form-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The night’s rising initiates a new act of speech.** `ن ش ء` B001 supplies rising upward, while B004 supplies beginning speech or action. Its attachment to `الليل`, after the command to rise, makes nocturnal emergence and the start of recitation coincide. I infer that the night session is powerful because it is a fresh beginning rather than leftover daytime activity. `ناشئة الليل` thus reads as both what rises in the night and the night-originated undertaking.

2. **`وطئًا` preserves concord and pressure as distinct mechanisms.** `و ط ء` B004 supplies the matching of hearing, heart, and tongue; B003 supplies severe pressing grip. The comparatives `أشد` and `أقوم` place `وطئًا` between intensity and straight speech. One abductive route says inner-outer concord makes speech straighter; another says the night’s pressure forces firmer verbal footing. The ayah can therefore describe either strongest correspondence or strongest impress, and the two should not be merged.

3. **Straight speech is something made to stand.** `ق و م` B008 supplies straightness and evenness, while B009 supplies a mainstay by which something remains standing; `ق و ل` B001 supplies uttered speech. The earlier ordered alignment (73:4) and later hostile sayings (73:10) give straight and unstable speech a social field. I infer that night practice provides the support by which utterance remains upright under opposition. `أقوم قيلًا` reads as structurally sustained speech, not merely better wording.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:10’s hostile sayings reveal why speech needs an upright mainstay, while 73:20 turns night formation into established prayer and feasible recitation amid competing demands. The later material makes “matching” more surprising than mere quiet: heart, hearing, tongue, and practice must remain concordant under pressure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The night's arising initiates formed speech.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ش ء B001` is rising upward, while `ن ش ء B004` is beginning speech or action; `ل ي ل B001` supplies the night setting. **Structural cue and role:** 73:1-5 move from wrapping, to standing, to ordered recitation, to reception of a saying, and this ayah culminates in `قيلا`. The speech-beginning branch gives `ناشئة` the role of an emergence in which the speaker and the saying are formed together. **Abductive move:** the sequence is supplied; I infer that the night practice generates a new capacity for speech rather than merely occupying a time slot. **Reading change:** `ناشئة الليل` can name a speech-forming onset, not only a portion or act that happens at night.

2. **Concord of faculties produces straighter saying.** **Lexical evidence:** `و ط ء B004` is one thing matching another, explicitly including concord of hearing, heart, and tongue; `ق و م B008` is straightness or just speech, and `ش د د B002` supplies intensity and firmness. **Structural cue and role:** the two comparatives `أشد ... وأقوم` coordinate stronger matching with straighter saying. The concord branch provides the internal mechanism, and straightness names its verbal result. **Abductive move:** the paired comparison is explicit; I infer the arrow from internal matching to rectified utterance. **Reading change:** `وطأ` reads as disciplined synchronization, and `أقوم قيلا` as its outward verbal effect.

3. **A firm embodied footing remains available beside concord.** **Lexical evidence:** `و ط ء B001` is a foot treading a spot, `ش د د B001` is fastening a bond, and `ق و م B002` is upright standing. **Structural cue and role:** these bodily branches repeat the prior imperative to stand and contrast with the wrapped starting state. They assign the night practice the role of fastening the speaker to a stable footing. **Abductive move:** the body-language is supplied; I infer that repeated embodied images model steadiness under the saying's weight. **Reading change:** the ayah can retain a physical reading of stronger footing without displacing the distinct concord reading.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:7's long daytime circulation supplied the contrast that explains why the night can produce tighter concord. 73:10 then revealed the practical test of `أقوم قيلا`: aligned speech must survive public talk without becoming reactive or ugly.

findings.text: Gecenin kalkışı, gündüzden artakalan bir etkinlik değil, sözün ve eylemin yeniden başladığı kurucu bir başlangıçtır.
Gecedeki etki, işitme, kalp ve dilin birbirine uymasıdır; bu iç uyum daha düzgün söyleyişin mekanizmasını oluşturur.
Etkinin baskı boyutu, ağır söz karşısında söyleyişi gevşetmek yerine daha sıkı bir dayanağa oturtur.
Gece çalışması, örtülü başlangıç durumundan çıkan kişiye bedensel bir basma ve sağlam durma zemini de kazandırır.
Düzgün söz, karşıt sözler arasında kendiliğinden ayakta kalmaz; gece çalışması ona süreklilik sağlayan bir ana destek olur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlamın çekirdeğini bir şeyin yükselmesi veya yükseltilmesi olarak kurar; bulutun yükselmesi ile gemi yelkenlerinin kaldırılması bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ortak yönü doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel yükselme ve yükseltmeyle sınırlıdır; yaratma, gençlerin yetişmesi veya bir işe başlama anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın yükselme kullanımını bulut ve gemi yelkeni gibi belirli yapılara bağlı kullanımlardan ayırarak tanımlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkması ya da yukarı kaldırılmasıdır; bulutun yükselmesi ve geminin yelkenlerini kaldırması bu hareketin belirli görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey fiziksel olarak yukarı çıkar veya daha yüksek bir konuma getirilir.
Bulutun havada belirmesiyle birlikte yükselmesi bu çekirdeğin doğal bir gerçekleşmesidir.
Gemiler için kullanım, yelkenlerin yukarı kaldırılmış veya gemilerce kaldırılıyor olmasını anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükselme çekirdeğinde birleşir ve bunu hem bulutun yukarı çıkması hem de gemi yelkenlerinin kaldırılmasıyla somutlaştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, başın, bakışın veya bir şeyin aşağı eğilmeksizin yukarıda tutulması durumuna özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda yukarı yön ve yüksek konum ortak bir görüntü oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir yükselme hareketini anlatır; komşu dalın ayırıcı yönü ise aşağıya yönelmeyen, yukarıda tutulan duruştur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; yayımlanan üç karşılaştırma fiziksel yükselmenin genel yükseklikten, saygınlık yüksekliğinden ve yukarıda tutulma durumundan ayrımını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ارتفاع الشيء وسموه، وارتفاع السحاب، ورفع القلع في السفن، وكل صورة يكون أصلها العلو أو الإعلاء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الخلق والإيجاد، ولا نشوء الشاب وتربيته، ولا ابتداء القول والفعل إلا من جهة القياس العام عند بعض المصادر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح يدل على ارتفاع في شيء وسمو، ونشأ السحاب ارتفع، وأنشأه الله رفعه (maqayis)؛ أنشأ الله السحاب فنشأ أي ارتفع (ayn)؛ نشأت السحابة ارتفعت، والجوار المنشآت السفن التي رفع قلعها (sihah)؛ نشأ ارتفع، ونشأت السحابة ارتفعت، والمنشآت السفن المرفوعات الشرع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi küçük yaştaki insanları, çocukluğu geride bırakıp gençliğe erişmeyi ve bir topluluk ya da yaşam çevresi içinde büyütülmeyi birlikte tanıklar. Verilen dal, bu insan gelişimi ve yetişme çekirdeğini doğru biçimde bir arada tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insanın büyüyüp gençliğe erişmesi ve yetiştirilmesiyle sınırlıdır; genel yaratma veya fiziksel yükselme anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın genç ve genç kuşak adları, bir topluluk içinde ya da süs içinde yetişme bildiren yapılara bağlı kullanımlardan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın çocukluk sınırını aşarak gençliğe doğru büyümesi ve belirli bir topluluk ya da yaşam çevresi içinde yetişmesidir; ad biçimleri ayrıca gençleri bir kuşak olarak gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Çocuk veya ergen, küçük yaş sınırını aşarak gençliğe ve yetişkin boyuna doğru büyür.
Ad biçimleri gençleri veya yetişme çağındaki yeni kuşağı topluca gösterebilir.
Bir topluluk içinde büyümek veya belirli bir yaşam çevresinde yetiştirilmek gelişimin çevresel yönünü belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar genç insan, küçük yaşı geride bırakma ve bir çevre içinde büyüyüp yetişme anlamlarını aynı gelişim alanında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir insanın çocukluktan gençliğe doğru gelişmesini anlatan çekirdek kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyüme sürecini ve gençlik eşiğine ulaşmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gençlerin veya yetişmekte olan yeni kuşağın topluca adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Genç insanları kuşak olarak gösteren toplu anlamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin hangi toplumsal çevrede büyüyüp yetiştiğinin belirtildiği yapılarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gelişim sürecini onu biçimlendiren toplulukla birlikte verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetiştirilme çevresinin süs ve bezekle nitelenmiş olduğu özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yetiştirilme eylemini ve süsle belirlenen çevreyi birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan büyümesini bitkinin sürmesi görüntüsüyle anlatır; saçın çıkmasını, beslemeyi ve bakım vermeyi de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın odağı çocukluktan gençliğe geçiş ve yetişme çevresidir; komşu dal bunu besleme, bakım ve bedensel filizlenme görüntüsüyle daha geniş işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gençlik eşiğini, genç kuşağı ve belirli bir topluluk içinde büyümeyi öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yaş evresine ve yetişme ortamına bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği besleme yoluyla büyütmedir ve bitkilere de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle bir kızın çocukluk evresinden çıkıp belirli bir olgunluk eşiğine ulaşmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de çocukluğun geride bırakıldığı gençlik eşiğine temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel büyüme ve yetişme sürecidir; komşu dal ise kız çocukları için daha dar ve belirli bir erişme durumunu adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal var olan bir insanın çocukluktan gençliğe büyümesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi varlığa getirme eylemini ve bazı kullanımlarda ardından yetiştirmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal canlıların gelişmesi ve yetiştirilmesi alanında kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişen kişinin yaşam içindeki büyümesine odaklanır; komşu dalın çekirdeği o varlığı meydana getirmektir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النشء والنشأ من أحداث الناس، والشاب أو الشابة حين يكبران، والنشوء في قوم أو في الحلية بمعنى التربية والنمو.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس خلق الشيء من العدم أو إيجاده ابتداء، ولا مجرد ارتفاع السحاب أو رفع القلع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النشء والنشأ أحداث الناس، ونشأ فلان في بني فلان، والناشئ الشاب الذي نشأ وارتفع وعلا (maqayis)؛ النشأ أحداث الناس الصغار، والناشئ الشاب (ayn)؛ الناشئ الحدث الذي قد جاوز حد الصغر، ونشأت في بني فلان إذا شببت فيهم (sihah)؛ الناشئ الشاب حين نشأ أي بلغ قامة الرجل، وغلام ناشئ وجارية ناشئة (tahdhib)؛ أومن ينشأ في الحلية أي يربى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir sabit gece ifadesi için birbiriyle aynı olmayan açıklamalar verir: geceleyin Tanrı'ya yönelmek için ayağa kalkma, gecenin ilk bölümü, bütün gece saatleri, gece içinde ortaya çıkan iyi işler veya uykudan sonraki vakit. Dal korunabilir, ancak bunlar tek bir birleşik anlam değil, kaynaklarda sunulan seçenekli yorumlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca sabit gece ifadesine bağlıdır ve gece kalkışıyla zaman dilimi yorumları birbirine karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca sabit gece ifadesinin tanıklanan yorumlarını kapsar; bunlardan genel bir yalın kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sabit gece ifadesi, kaynağa göre geceleyin Tanrı'ya yönelmek için ayağa kalkmayı ya da gecenin başlangıcı, bütün saatleri, uykudan sonraki bölümü veya gece içinde ortaya çıkan iyi işleri gösterebilir. Bu yorumlar seçeneklidir ve tek bir zaman sınırında birleşmez.

facets.statement: Anlam, gece içinde başlayan bir kalkışa, eyleme veya zaman bölümüne gönderme yapan sabit ifadeye bağlıdır.
Bir yorum, geceleyin Tanrı'ya yönelmek amacıyla yataktan kalkıp ayakta durmayı belirtir.
Başka yorumlar ifadeyi gecenin ilk saatleri, bütün gece saatleri veya gece içinde başlayan iyi işler olarak açıklar.
Daha dar bir yorum, gecenin uyku sonrasında kalan bölümünü veya o sırada gerçekleşen kalkışı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık sabit ifadeyi gece içindeki bir başlangıç veya kalkış fikrine bağlar; fakat bunun gece kalkışı mı, ilk saatler mi, bütün gece mi, iyi işler mi yoksa uykudan sonraki bölüm mü olduğu konusunda farklı yorumlar aktarır.

concept_gloss.text: gece içinde başlayan kalkış ya da zaman dilimi

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لفظ ناشئة الليل وما ينشأ فيه من قيام أو ساعات أو أول الليل أو ما بعد النوم بحسب اختلاف المصادر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir işe koyulmayı, konuşmaya başlamayı, sözlü anlatılar kurmayı ve şiir söylemeye ya da söylev vermeye girişmeyi açıkça tanıklar. Verilen dal bu başlangıç çekirdeğini korur ve söz üretme kullanımını onun özel bir gerçekleşmesi olarak taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnızca verilen eylem ve söz yapılarına bağlıdır; genel yaratma, gelme veya yönelme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, başlama veya söz üretme anlamını yalnızca tanıklanan eylem, konuşma, şiir ve söylev yapıları içinde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir işi veya konuşmayı başlatıp ona girişmektir; söz alanındaki özel kullanımlar bir anlatıyı kurmayı, şiir söylemeye ya da söylev vermeye başlamayı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişi belirli bir işi, söyleme eylemini veya konuşmayı başlatıp sürdürmeye koyulur.
Sözlü anlatılar için kullanım, bunları yalnızca başlatmanın yanında kurup ortaya koymayı da anlatabilir.
Şiir söylemeye veya söylev vermeye başlamak, kimi tanıklıkta bunu iyi yapmakla birlikte verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir işe veya söze başlamada birleşir; konuşma kurma, şiir söyleme ve söylev verme bu başlangıç anlamının söz alanındaki gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin anlamsal içeriği rüzgârı burna doğru çekip koklamak konusunda açıktır; ancak tanıklardan biri bu yazılışın bu köke ait olmadığını ve benzer sesli başka bir kökten geldiğini belirtir. branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استنشأت الريح أو يستنشئ الريح بمعنى تشممها، مع التنبيه إلى خلاف المصدر الذي رده إلى نشيت غير المهموز.

branches.source_phrase_ar: استنشأت الريح تشممتها كأنك ترفعها إلى أنفك (maqayis)؛ الذئب يستنشئ الريح بالهمز، وإنما هو من نشيت الريح غير مهموز أي شممتها (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi yaratıp varlığa getirmeyi açıkça tanıklar ve bir açıklama bu sürece yetiştirme ve geliştirmeyi de ekler. Verilen dal bu çekirdeği doğru kurar; geliştirme öğesi genel yaratmanın eş anlamlısı değil, özellikle canlılara dönük genişlemedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir şeyi meydana getirme çekirdeğine dayanır; söz söylemeye başlama, insanın doğal büyümesi veya fiziksel yükselme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimlerindeki var etme anlamı, Tanrı'nın yaratmasını ve canlıyı var edip yetiştirmeyi bildiren yapılara bağlı kullanımlardan ayrılarak verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yokken meydana getirip varlığa kavuşturmaktır; özellikle canlılar için bazı kullanımlar var etmenin ardından onu geliştirip yetiştirmeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir varlık veya oluş, onu meydana getiren bir güç tarafından varlığa getirilir.
Özellikle canlılara ilişkin kullanım, var etmenin yanında gelişimini sürdürme ve yetiştirme aşamasını da içerebilir.
Tanrı'nın yaratması söz konusu olduğunda eylem, bu dünyadaki veya sonraki var oluşu meydana getirmeyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yaratıp var etme çekirdeğini verir; toplu tanıklıkta buna, özellikle canlılar söz konusu olduğunda, geliştirme ve yetiştirme aşaması da eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyi meydana getirme çekirdeğini ve canlılara ilişkin kullanımlarda onu yetiştirip geliştirme uzantısını birlikte anlatmak için uygundur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنشاء الله للشيء وخلقه، والنشأة بمعنى الإحداث والإيجاد، مع ما في Mufradat من ضم التربية إلى الإيجاد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı havuz terimini destek taşları veya yan parçalar, ilk yapılan bölüm ve havuzun altına konan taş olarak açıklar. Bunlar havuzun yapısal başlangıç ve destek öğesi çevresinde birleşse de tek ve değişmez bir parçayı göstermediği için dal bu seçenekli kapsamla korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca havuz yapısındaki ilk, alt veya destekleyici taş bölüme aittir; genel yükseltme ya da yapma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın terimin havuza özgü bütün tanıklanan parça yorumlarını kapsar ve başka yapılara bağlı anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yerde kurulan bir havuzun yapımında ilk yerleştirilen, altında bulunan veya çevresini destekleyen taş bölümüdür; kaynaklar parçanın tam konumunu farklı biçimlerde belirtir.

facets.statement: Terim havuzun yapımına ve sağlam durmasına hizmet eden temel bir taş bölümünü gösterir.
Bir yorum terimi yerdeki havuzun çevresine dikilen destek taşları veya yan parçaları olarak açıklar.
Başka yorumlar terimi havuzun ilk yapılan bölümü ya da en altına konan taş olarak belirler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar terimi havuzun yapısal bir taş parçası sayar; ancak bunun çevre destekleri mi, ilk yapılan bölüm mü yoksa taban taşı mı olduğu konusunda farklı açıklamalar verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النشيئة من الحوض: أعضاده أو أول ما يعمل منه أو الحجر الذي يجعل أسفله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل نشوء أو إنشاء، ولا رفعا عاما بلا تعلق بالحوض.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yerden gelmeyi, bir yöne doğru yaklaşmayı, ihtiyaç için ayağa kalkıp yürümeyi ve gemilerin yaklaşıp uzaklaşmasını aynı yönlü hareket alanında verir. Verilen dal bu gelme, yönelme ve harekete geçme çekirdeğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek bir yer değiştirme veya yönelme hareketi gerektirir; söz söylemeye başlama ya da bir şeyi yaratma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın gelme ve yaklaşma kullanımı, ihtiyaç için kalkıp yürüme ve gemilerin yaklaşıp uzaklaşması gibi yapılara bağlı görünümlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerden gelip bir hedefe doğru yönelmek veya ona yaklaşmaktır; ihtiyaç için ayağa kalkıp yürümek ve gemilerin yaklaşıp sonra uzaklaşması bu hareketin özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Hareket eden kişi veya varlık bir çıkış noktasından gelir ve bir hedefe doğru yaklaşır.
Bir ihtiyacı karşılamak için ayağa kalkıp ona doğru yürümek, amaçlı yönelme görünümüdür.
Gemiler için kullanım onların yaklaşmasını ve ardından uzaklaşmasını hareketin iki yönü olarak verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık gelme ve yaklaşma çekirdeğini, ihtiyaç için kalkıp yürüme ve gemilerin yaklaşıp uzaklaşması örnekleriyle genişletir.

facets.statement: Gündüzün karşıtı olan zaman bölümü gecedir; tek bir gece veya birden çok gece olarak sayılabilir.

Bir başka pekiştirme kalıbı gecenin uzunluğunu veya şiddetini özellikle öne çıkarır.
Özel bir söz öbeği, ayın hem en karanlık hem de son gecesini belirtir.

source_note.TA: Tek tanıklık, günün ilk yarısında tamamlanmış bir eylem için önceki gecenin bu ifadeyle anılabildiğini, gün ilerleyince başka bir geçmiş zaman sözünün seçildiğini ve gündüzden bakıldığında yaklaşan gecenin de aynı yakınlık ilkesiyle belirlendiğini bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir biçimin kadın adı olduğunu ve bu adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeğinin şarabı örtülü biçimde anlattığını doğrular. Dal bir adlandırma kümesi olarak korunabilir; ancak kadın adının kendi başına şarap anlamına geldiği sanılmamalı, şarap anlamı yalnız tam söz öbeğine bağlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kadın adı temel adlandırma kullanımıdır; şarap anlamı yalnız ayrı ve tam bir söz öbeğinin örtülü ad işlevine aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız ad olarak kullanılan biçimi ve şarabı anan tam söz öbeğini kapsar; bunlar genel gece veya karanlık anlamına genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir biçimin kadın adı olarak kullanılmasıdır; aynı adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeği ise şarabı anan örtülü bir ad işlevi görür. İki kullanım aynı dalda bulunsa da kadın adı ile içki anlamı birbirine eşit değildir.

facets.statement: Söz konusu biçim bir kadını adlandıran kişi adı olarak kullanılır.
Bu adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeği, şarabı doğrudan söylemeden anan örtülü bir ad olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt kadın adı kullanımını ortak biçimde destekler ve ayrıca bu adı içeren tam bir söz öbeğinin şarabı örten bir ad olduğunu bildirir. İkinci kullanım bağımsız söz öbeğine bağlı tutulmalıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi adı çekirdeğini ve yalnız tam söz öbeğine bağlı şarap adlandırmasını sınırlarıyla birlikte açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Kadın adı ile söz öbeğine bağlı örtülü şarap adını ayrı tutarak korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi bağlayıp düğümünü sağlamlaştırmayı temel anlam olarak verir; birinin gücünü destekleme ve yönetimi güçlendirme kullanımlarını da açıkça buna bağlar. Bu nedenle dal kimliği kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Somut bağlama çekirdeği, yalnız belirli söz öbeklerinde görülen destek ve yönetim güçlendirme kullanımlarıyla karıştırılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nesneyi bağlayıp sağlamlaştıran temel kullanım ile söz öbeğine bağlı destek ve yönetim güçlendirme kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bağlamak, düğümünü sıkılaştırmak ve çözülmeyecek kadar sağlam duruma getirmektir. Belirli söz öbeklerinde bu işlem, birine destek verip gücünü artırma ya da bir yönetimi sağlamlaştırma yönünde genişler.

facets.statement: Bir nesne bağlanır, düğümü sıkılır ve bağlantısı sağlamlaştırılır.
Birinin gücüne destek olmak, onun dayanma ve iş görme gücünü artırmak olarak anlatılır.
Bir yönetimin gücü ve sağlamlığı artırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, bağlama ve düğümü sağlamlaştırma işlemidir. Destek verilen kişinin gücünü ve bir yönetimin dayanıklılığını artıran kullanımlar bu somut çekirdeğin genişlemeleri olarak sunulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi güç, katılık, yüreklilik ve dayanıklılığı dalın çekirdeği olarak destekler; çetin zaman, kıtlık, eziyet, artırma, güç yetirme ve çaba harcama kullanımlarını da ayrıca verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu yapıya bağlı kullanımlar yalın güç anlamıyla özdeşleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel güç ve katılık niteliği, çetin durumlar ile belirli yapılardaki artırma, güç yetirme ve çaba anlamlarından ayrılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel güç, katılık ve çetinlik anlamları ile yalnız belirli biçim ve söz öbeklerinde görülen artırma, güç yetirme ve çaba kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlıkta bedensel güç, katılık, dayanıklılık ya da yürek sağlamlığı olarak görülen yüksek yoğunluk; durumlarda ise çetinlik, kıtlık ve eziyetin ağırlığıdır. Aynı kökten gelen sınırlı yapılarda bir şeyi hafifletmenin karşıtı olarak artırma, bir işe gücü yetme ya da yetmeme, bütün gücünü harcama ve güçlü bir bineğe sahip olma anlatılır.

facets.statement: Bir beden, nesne ya da kişi güçlü, katı, dayanıklı, yürekli ve sarsılmaz olarak nitelenir.
Bir zaman, açlık ya da eziyet ağır ve katlanılması güç bir durum olarak anlatılır.
Belirli bir ad, hafifletmenin karşıtı olan artırma ve ağırlaştırma işlemini bildirir.
Karşıt iki eylemi yapamama kalıbı, kişinin hiçbir şeye gücünün yetmediğini bildirir.
Şarkı söyleyen kişinin sesini yükseltirken bütün gücünü harcaması anlatılır.
Bir kişinin ya da topluluğun güçlü bir bineğe veya güçlü binekler topluluğuna sahip olması anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bedende, nesnede veya kişilikte güç, katılık ve dayanıklılıktır; ağır zaman, açlık ve eziyet bu yoğunluğun durumlara uzanmasıdır. Ayrıca hafifletmenin karşıtı olan artırma, güç yetirememeyi bildiren kalıp, var gücüyle ses çıkarma ve güçlü bineğe sahip olma gibi sınırlı kullanımlar aktarılır.
